record.summary: Creates the Spanish Agency for the Supervision of Artificial Intelligence (AESIA), a state agency based in A Coruña, and approves its statute. The Agency supervises, advises, raises awareness and trains public and private bodies on implementing national and European AI rules, with inspection, verification and sanction functions under the applicable European rules. Its competences include promoting test environments for AI systems, a voluntary certification framework, supervising AI systems used by public administrations, and supervising AI systems that may pose significant risks to health, safety, equal treatment and other fundamental rights.
record.notes: Approved by the Council of Ministers on 22 Aug 2023, published in BOE no. 210 on 2 Sep 2023 and in force from 3 Sep 2023. It was processed urgently under a Council of Ministers agreement of 13 Jun 2023, so that the Agency could prepare for the obligations of the then proposed EU AI Act. AESIA is attached to the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Digital Transformation through the State Secretariat for Digitalisation and Artificial Intelligence, and was to start operating when its Governing Council was constituted, within three months of entry into force. Its powers are without prejudice to those of the Ministry of Health and the Spanish Agency of Medicines and Medical Devices.

safety_topics.locator: Estatuto, artículo 26 (Subdirección de Certificación, Evaluación de Tendencias, Coordinación y Formación)
safety_topics.quote: Supervisar de oficio de los sistemas de inteligencia artificial utilizados por las administraciones públicas, así como la emisión de informes vinculantes

notes.quote: este real decreto se ha tramitado por la vía administrativa urgente por Acuerdo de Consejo de Ministros de fecha 13 de junio de 2023
La Agencia se adscribe al Ministerio de Asuntos Económicos y Transformación Digital, a través de la Secretaría de Estado de Digitalización e Inteligencia Artificial.
La efectiva puesta en funcionamiento de la Agencia se producirá con la constitución del Consejo Rector en el plazo máximo de 3 meses desde la entrada en vigor de este real decreto.
Todo ello sin menoscabo de las competencias y funciones que en este ámbito vienen ejerciendo el Ministerio de Sanidad y la Agencia Española de Medicamentos y Productos Sanitarios

changes.summary: rewritten from Articles 2, 4 and 10 of the Statute; the claim that AESIA is 'the first national AI supervisory agency in the EU' is not in any stored file and was removed; adds supervision of AI used by public administrations and of systems posing significant risks to health, safety and fundamental rights
changes.safety_topics: 'public-sector use' added: the Statute gives the Agency ex officio supervision of AI systems used by public administrations, with binding reports on whether they continue
changes.notes: the remarks on the 2025 draft AI governance law and the European Commission's list of single points of contact are not in this record's stored files and were removed (the draft law is ES-03, already related); the urgent procedure, the attachment to the ministry, the start of operations and the reservation for health authorities were added from the decree

judgment.status_reasoning: Decree of 22 Aug 2023, published in BOE no. 210 on 2 Sep 2023; under the third final provision it entered into force the next day, 3 Sep 2023, as the BOE analysis states.
